newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks close off in troubled session.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks close off in troubled session.

text.p: Caracas stocks closed off in a slow session curbed by a liquidity squeeze and troubled by possibly accelerated exchange rate depreciation, traders said.

"There's been no liquidity," said one trader noting that the overnight interbank lending rate had bounced between 10 and 75 percent. "There's also been some exchange rate pressure, with rumors of accelerated depreciation, and that has boosted dollar demand," he added.
The bolsa's 19-share index closed off 1.26 percent at 6,548.33 percent as 17 million shares traded, worth 3.6 billion bolivars ($7.5 million).
Delays in approving electricity tariff increases also put off investors during the day's skittish trade, brokers said.
Steel company Sivensa led losers, closing off 2.66 percent at 155.75 bolivars as 25 stocks fell, seven rose and two closed flat.
Merinvest's composite index, which includes telephone company CANTV, meanwhile fell 1.32 percent to 103.88 points.
